Dictionary description ('public security services provided by the national police') agrees. Words are the official Spanish questionnaire p.5 (checked against the rendered page image at 200 dpi); the dictionary variable labels agree character-for-character on 8/8 items, so no wording override. Items A1, A2 and A5 speak of 'emergencias' in a police block (wording shared with the P04A10 emergencies block); shipped as printed, not corrected. Printed line breaks (A7, B stem) joined with a single space; wide gaps in the justified B stem on the page image are typesetting, the PDF text layer and the dictionary label both have single spaces, as shipped. Structure (mirrors batch_627/638 siblings): the P04A09 left-hand framing 'Con relación a la seguridad pública' (no final punctuation, as printed) -> instructions; the P04A09A lead-in 'Durante el 2024, usted considera que el servicio de seguridad pública (Policía Nacional Civil -PNC-):' is shared by A1-A7 -> section_prompt of section _1; P04A09B -> section _2, no prompt. This block has no screener question. Interviewer lines 'Lea las opciones.' / 'Espere la respuesta.' not shipped. Options as printed: A1-A7 SÍ 1 / NO 2 / NS 3 (dictionary value labels identical); the do-file recodes only 98, so resp 3 NS (don't know) is kept on A1-A7 (nominal yes/no/don't-know, not ordinal). P04A09B prints bare 1-10 bubbles plus 98 'NO SABE / NO RESPONDE' (dictionary value labels = own number; 98 labelled 'No sabe / no responde'); option_text for resp 1 and 10 carries the endpoint anchors defined in the stem, 2-9 left blank; code 98 set missing by the do-file without dropping rows. Item content note: A7 (bribe request) is negatively worded, so SÍ is the unfavourable answer there. No skip pattern: every one of the 6,886 Hogares rows is non-blank on all eight columns in the source xlsx. Route 9 (server-side GROUP BY on the live table, no export) against ENCASBA.2024_Hogares.xlsx value counts: 31/31 valid item x resp cells equal (a1 1/2/3 = 2522/3507/857; a2 3004/2570/1312; a3 3300/2821/765; a4 3471/2242/1173; a5 2704/2990/1192; a6 2707/3246/933; a7 591/5939/356; b 1..10 = 624/263/353/376/1094/547/638/918/409/1037) and the single NULL cell equals the source code-98 count (b 627 NULL live = 627 code 98 in source); a1-a7 have 0 NULL in both.
